name: Arc Table Lamp
description: A warm little pool of light for slow evenings. The sculptural curved stem and soft linen shade make this a piece that feels at home on a bedside table or a reading nook.

name: Cloud Ceramic Vase
description: Inspired by cloud-soft forms, each vase is shaped and glazed by hand. Its gentle silhouette looks lovely with a few stems or simply on its own.

name: Sunday Woven Throw
description: A breathable cotton throw for the sofa, the balcony, and everything in between. Woven in a subtle check that adds texture without asking for attention.

name: Studio Stoneware Mug
description: Your first cup deserves a good mug. A comfortable handle, a generous shape, and a speckled glaze that makes every piece a little different.

name: Arch Wall Mirror
description: A simple arch that opens up a room. Slim oak detailing and a clean reflection make it an easy fit in an entryway, bedroom, or anywhere that needs a little light.

name: Everyday Oak Board
description: A sturdy everyday board for chopping, serving, or bringing a little warmth to the table. Made from responsibly sourced Indian oak.

name: Loom Linen Cushion
description: Relaxed linen with just the right amount of softness. A small detail that makes a sofa feel more like yours. Comes with a feather-free insert.

name: Monsoon Reed Diffuser
description: The first rain on warm earth, bottled for your home. Notes of vetiver, cedar, and a hint of citrus drift gently through the room.
